# bobina

> A command-line tool that prints Markdown (receipts, lists, labels, QR codes, payment codes like Pix, UPI or SEPA, images) on 58/80 mm thermal
> roll printers over Bluetooth, a device file or a command. Every print shows a confirmation screen first. Nothing
> is refused: problems are "nudges" with a code, a message and a suggestion.

Facts an agent needs first:

- Without a terminal, add `--yes`: `bobina print FILE --yes`. Otherwise the print stops with E107 (exit 7).
- To look without printing: `bobina check FILE` (paper length and problems), `bobina view FILE` (terminal preview),
  `bobina preview FILE -o out.png` (exact image). `print -n` shows the confirmation screen and prints nothing.
- Inline text works as a document: `bobina print "# TITLE\n- [ ] item" --yes`.
- One label per row: `--data rows.csv` (CSV, TSV, JSON, .xlsx with `--sheet`), `--where COL=VAL`,
  `--copies-from COL`, `--join FILE --on KEY`, `--set KEY=VALUE`; `bobina help data` has them on one screen.
- A problem code in an error or warning: `bobina help CODE` (that code) says what to do.
- The whole CLI for programs: `bobina help --json` (commands, options, topics, every problem code).
- Machine output: `check --json` gives `{"stats", "problems"}`; `--problems json|jsonl` writes problems to stderr;
  exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 document, 3 strict, 4 unreachable, 5 printer not ready, 6 language,
  7 confirmation, 8 security, 9 a payment code left out (Q111).
- Reprint: `print --last` (identical bytes) or `--again` (re-rendered); `-o FILE` saves bytes instead of printing.
- Try without hardware: `bobina printer add test --path out.bin` (a file printer).
- An MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor): `uv tool install 'bobina[mcp]'`, `claude mcp add bobina -- bobina mcp`;
  tools check, preview, print (prints only with `confirm: true`), help, templates ([CLI](docs/CLI.md#agents-bobina-mcp)).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, the document format in one screen, every command in one table
- [CLI reference](docs/CLI.md): commands and options, problems and exit codes, strips (`--compact`, `--marks`), calibration
- [Document format](docs/FORMAT.md): the `.bob.md` format and the catalog of problem codes
- [Batch printing guide](docs/guides/batch-printing.md): one label per row of a spreadsheet, step by step
- [Payment codes](docs/pay.md): every `pay` scheme (Pix, UPI, SEPA…), what each field means in it and its limits
- [Templates guide](docs/guides/templates.md): label, card and to-do recipes, and a gallery of shop tags
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): data is printed literally, templates run in a sandbox
- [Install](docs/INSTALL.md): the installer script, apt, Homebrew; Bluetooth needs the system Python
- [Problem codes](docs/problems/README.md): one page per code, with what to do
- [JSON schemas](docs/schemas/README.md): check --json, problems, history
- [What was tested on paper](docs/TESTED.md): features marked ⚠ not tested on paper (note P301)
